source.title: Appassionata, Op.57 — Allegro ma non troppo — Presto

bars.description: Development/recapitulation repeat: body118–299, first ending300–307, second308–309. Presto printed316; its two repeated bodies316–322 and325–333 have separate first/second endings. Canonical371bars become569performed bars; published MIDI already unfolds this order. Printed-source numbering counts alternative endings, unlike some standard bar-number conventions.

endpoints.basis: The first B-flat2/G3/E4/C-sharp5 diminished chord peaks at0.46s; the broad search's2.02s value selected a later recurrence. Complete ending pitch inspection confirms the final lower-register F-minor chord near420.76s: later energy near421.3s is within its decay, not a substitute last attack. These are source-pitch fitting windows, not independent or aural validation.

anchors.label: first-development-quiet-E6-apex
anchors.basis: Absolute pitch features resolve the E6/MIDI88 apex at136.84s, following the C5/E5/G5/B-flat5 ascent. The initial successful numerical pass put it around137.60s, after the measured rise. This fixes the first development's quiet arpeggio without removing notes or the pause before the low continuation near139.1s; it is a fitting constraint, not independent validation.
